_comment: One entry per installer. build.ps1 -Edition <key> builds it. Each edition is the same program with a different AI model inside; the app still fits its settings to the computer it lands on, and more .gguf models can be added later (Settings shows them).

mistral-24b.title: Mistral Small 24B
mistral-24b.for: Computers with 32 GB of memory or more. Integrated graphics works (notes take a while); a graphics card with 16 GB or more makes it fast.
